findings: Five-event partial order has ten interleavings by binomial coefficient.
Snapshot-only unsafe orders are exactly S-P-U-W-R, S-P-W-U-R and S-P-U-R-W for S snapshot,P pin,U publish,W sweep,R unpin.
Current-closure recheck preserves the invariant by induction on pin,publish,unpin,snapshot,sweep; one collection-first admission rejects.
Stale pins preserve safety but may prevent reclamation; unfenced expiry permits stale publication.
Generation-token, custody and backup paragraphs are proposed designs, not verified implementation.
